## 🐛 Fixed

- **A receiving server for nodes without a pairing group.** An instance without a pairing group can now set up its receiving server for its nodes. When you pick the receiving server for a node and none runs yet, the placement step offers Set up receiving server, and this instance's card on Instances opens it too. Thanks to @LukasStipar for the report.
- **A node's placement finishes on its own.** Closing the window while home tells a node where its backups go no longer leaves the node half set up. Home finishes the placement in its own time.
- **Folder sets on a node read as protected.** After a successful backup, a node's folder set said Not protected, because the node keeps its own schedule off while home plans it. It now counts the way the node's containers do.
- **The receiving server window speaks of nodes on an instance without a group.** It no longer asks for an Address for partners there, since there are none.

## 🌐 Translations

- **The new lines in the receiving server window in all 42 languages,** and the docs on nodes and the receiving server in all 26.
